summary: Follow one model call as it gains document context, tools, memory, a decision loop and coordinated workers.
scope: A capability progression inspired by Rakesh Gohel’s illustration. Each step adds a design option. Real systems can choose the simplest combination that meets their needs.
author: Thoth

componentNotes.model: Produces an answer or proposes the next action from the context it receives.
componentNotes.prepare: Extracts and bounds input before it reaches inference. File contents stay untrusted.
componentNotes.format: Validates the output shape and renders a usable answer or artifact.
componentNotes.tools: Validates tool arguments and enforces permissions before executing a call.
componentNotes.knowledge: Returns candidate passages and source metadata for the current task.
componentNotes.session: Keeps the working context for this run. State can expire at the end of the session.
componentNotes.memory: Stores selected facts or preferences under an explicit retention policy.
componentNotes.episodes: Keeps summaries of relevant past runs for later retrieval.
componentNotes.decision: Checks the result, remaining budget and required approvals before choosing whether to continue.
componentNotes.orchestrator: Assigns scoped work and tracks deadlines, retries and results.
componentNotes.review: Checks evidence and policy before a result is delivered or returned for revision.
componentNotes.approval: A person reviews sensitive actions before the system can proceed.
componentNotes.trace: Records decisions, tool calls and outcomes for debugging and evaluation.
